review_candidates.title: Cloud Reliability Engineer
review_candidates.description: Description - Job Summary This role is responsible for leading the design, engineering, deployment, and reliability of cloud platforms, infrastructure, and services. As a key member of the Cloud Reliability Engineering team, this position focuses on ensuring the availability, scalability, resiliency, security, and operational excellence of cloud-native solutions. The role drives automation, observability, incident management, and continuous improvement while partnering with engineering teams to deliver highly reliable and secure cloud services that support current and future business needs. Responsibilities Lead the design, deployment, and management of cloud platforms and infrastructure while aligning with business, architectural, and security requirements. Own the availability, reliability, scalability, and operational health of cloud services and platforms. Design and implement cloud solutions and infrastructure that protect and manage cloud-native applications and data. Build and own observability capabilities, including monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, dashboards, and reliability metrics. Establish and maintain Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and operational reliability standards. Lead incident response, root cause analysis, problem management, and continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure production environments meet HP security standards by coordinating security reviews, vulnerability remediation, compliance assessments, and penetration testing. Build standards and automate infrastructure provisioning, deployment, configuration management, and operational processes using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and DevSecOps practices. Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to develop tooling, automation, and platform capabilities supporting cloud operations, microservices, and distributed systems. Contribute to cloud platform strategy, architecture decisions, engineering roadmaps, and proof-of-concept initiatives. Drive capacity planning, performance optimization, disaster recovery, and business continuity readiness. Champion CI/CD, automated testing, and reliability engineering best practices. Create operational runbooks, technical standards, and architecture documentation, and provide mentorship on cloud reliability and operational excellence. Education & Experience Recommended Four-year or Graduate Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence. Typically has 7-10 years of work experience, preferably in distributed & cloud computing, software & cloud design, programming languages, agile development methodologies, or a related field. Preferred Certifications AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, CSA certified Knowledge & Skills Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering High Availability & Disaster Recovery Observability, Monitoring & Alerting Incident Management & Root Cause Analysis Service Level Objectives (SLOs) & SLIs Performance & Capacity Engineering AWS, Azure, and GCP Kubernetes & Docker Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep) DevOps & CI/CD Cloud Security & Compliance Python, Java, and APIs Microservices & Distributed Systems Automation Engineering Impact & Scope Serves as a technical leader for cloud reliability, resiliency, availability, and operational excellence initiatives. Influences cloud platform strategy, operational standards, security posture, and reliability practices across multiple product and engineering teams. Leads complex projects and provides technical leadership for enterprise-scale cloud platforms and services. Complexity Works on highly complex cloud infrastructure and distributed systems challenges where analysis requires evaluating multiple technical, operational, security, and business factors. Exercises substantial independent judgment in establishing reliability standards, operational policies, and engineering best practices. Drives resolution of critical production issues and reliability risks with enterprise-wide impact. Pay & Benefits The pay range for this role is $130,700 to $205,200 USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Benefits HP offers a comprehensive benefits package for this position, including: Health insurance Dental insurance Vision insurance Long term/short term disability insurance Employee assistance program Flexible spending account Life insurance Generous time off policies, including; 4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure 11 paid holidays Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave US benefits overview https://hpbenefits.ce.alight.com/ The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law. Disclaimer This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management. review_candidates.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: UK CITIZENSHIP REQUIRED FOR THIS POSITION: Yes RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time Location: Cheltenham Clearance: Highest Level of Uk Governement Clearance What’s your possible? At Northrop Grumman UK , you are part of a team driving innovation where it matters most, solving tomorrow’s challenges and shaping the technology solutions of the future. We call it Defining Possible . This mindset goes beyond our customer solutions. It underpins how we invest in our people, support career development, and create opportunities to make a meaningful impact for our customers, communities, and colleagues. This is more than just a job. It's a mission. As a DevOps Engineer within our National Security Solutions business, you will play a critical role in helping deliver secure, resilient, and innovative technology solutions that support some of the UK's most important programmes. Working alongside Architects, Software Engineers, Testers and Infrastructure specialists, you'll help build, automate, and optimise mission-critical environments. You'll be part of agile, multidisciplinary teams delivering real-world outcomes, using modern DevSecOps practices, cloud technologies, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD tooling to solve complex technical challenges. Whether you're improving platform reliability, enabling faster software delivery, or helping organisations become cloud ready, your work will directly contribute to the success of systems that matter. "As a Lead DevOps Engineer I implement and improve end to end CI/CD pipelines to promote stable and efficient environments throughout the SDLC. Using multiple toolsets to automate repetitive processes, monitor and analyse system performance, and enable projects to focus on getting the best value from their tools. I document and share knowledge to help projects grow and learn from previous issues, mentoring junior colleagues to follow best practices." Craig, Lead DevOps Engineer, National Security Solutions, Northrop Grumman UK Joining our Infrastructure Discipline offers the opportunity to work with industry-leading specialists across public cloud and on-premise environments, delivering innovative solutions to highly complex engineering challenges. What You'll Do Design, build and maintain secure, resilient, mission-critical systems in collaboration with technical and business stakeholders. Automate deployment, configuration and operational activities using Infrastructure as Code and configuration management tools. Create, improve and maintain CI/CD pipelines that support reliable and high-quality software delivery. Lead technical discussions and recommend effective DevOps tools and practices to solve complex project challenges. Support cloud migration initiatives and the adoption of containerised and microservices-based architectures. Monitor, analyse and continuously improve system performance, reliability and operational efficiency. What We're Looking For We're interested in hearing from people with experience in several of the following areas: Building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, Concourse, Maven or Bamboo. Automation and scripting using Ansible, Bash, PowerShell, Puppet or Python. Managing virtualised and containerised environments including VMware, Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShift. Working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud. Using collaboration and delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence and Bitbucket within Agile environments. Monitoring and observability using tools such as Elastic Stack and Grafana. Desirable Experience Includes Designing, deploying and administering Linux or Unix-based platforms. Implementing Infrastructure as Code and DevSecOps practices. Supporting cloud transformation and modernisation programmes. If you don't meet every requirement but feel your skills and experience are relevant, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as technical expertise. Security Clearance Due to the nature of our work, you must be a UK national and able to gain and maintain UK Government security clearance in line with the job role and requirements. Our recruitment team is on hand to answer any questions and will guide you through the process: talentenquiries@uk.ngc.com Benefits At Northrop Grumman UK, we recognise that our people are our greatest asset. That's why we offer a comprehensive rewards package that supports your wellbeing, development and lifestyle: Flexible and hybrid working arrangements Compressed fortnight option with every other Friday off (where project requirements allow) Private healthcare, dental cover, life assurance and pension Flexible benefits package including critical illness cover and health cash plan Holiday buy and sell scheme Annual performance incentive programme Professional development, training and certification support Career development programmes and mentoring opportunities Why Join Us? A Mission to Believe In Every day, we contribute to building a more secure and connected world. You'll work on meaningful programmes that protect national interests while having opportunities to support STEM initiatives, community engagement and employee-led networks. A Place to Belong and Thrive Diversity of thought, background and experience strengthens our teams and our solutions. We foster an inclusive culture where everyone is respected, supported and empowered to succeed. Your Career, Your Way Discover your possible through varied projects, access to emerging technologies, professional development opportunities, and a network of experienced colleagues committed to helping you grow. Ready to apply? Yes – Submit your application online. Possibly – Reach out to our team for more information at talentenquiries@uk.ngc.com . No – Explore other opportunities with Northrop Grumman UK. We're growing across the UK and are always looking for talented people to help us define what's possible. Northrop Grumman is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce, and encourages individuals from all backgrounds and all abilities to apply and consider becoming a part of our diverse and inclusive workforce.
